card.name: Linking words in drug interaction lists
card.fires_on: Words just before a list or number in drug-label text, such as "effect" after anticholinergic or glucose-lowering, "than" or "least" before a percentage, and "YP" inside CYP enzyme names.

modes.label: Effect after a drug property
modes.description: The word effect after anticholinergic or blood glucose lowering, before a drug name or example list.

modes.label: Before a percentage
modes.description: Wording like less than or at least that comes right before a percentage of patients.

modes.label: Inside CYP enzyme names
modes.description: The YP part of CYP in lists of enzyme interactions.
modes.example: CYP1A2: duloxetine, tacrine, tizanidine, theophylline C<<YP>>2C19: lansop
